description: Multilingual retrieval golden set for Agronaut's knowledge base. French (FR) and Traditional Chinese (ZH-TW) versions of all 33 English golden queries, written in OPERATOR voice — symptom-first, messy, phrased the way a grower would actually type, NOT textbook translations and NOT the vocabulary of the documents that should answer them. Same `relevant` labels as the English originals (ground truth is a property of the CORPUS, not of the query language). Negative controls are also translated: an off-topic question must stay off-topic in any language. See golden_set.json for the English originals and docs/dpg/retrieval_eval/ for the measurement history.

_translation_note: Written by a coding agent (blut-agent), not a native speaker — flagged here per the issue's honesty note ('written by someone who speaks the language'). The FR phrasings use grower register; the ZH-TW phrasings use Taiwan vocabulary (吳郭魚 for tilapia, 九層塔 for basil, 抽水馬達 for pump). A maintainer or native speaker should review the phrasings before treating per-language numbers as production truth; the labels, however, need no review (they are copied from the English set).
_method_note: Each id is `<english-id>-fr` or `<english-id>-zh`; the label mapping is IDENTICAL to the English original because ground truth is a property of the corpus. BM25 will contribute almost nothing for ZH (the corpus is English and the tokenizer is whitespace-based) — that asymmetry is itself a measurement this set makes visible.
